title: a creation taken back on a superseded reading
line: a person the rule created from a death record, the creation taken back after the page was read again and its card left undecided on the superseded reading as an older matcher's, is no new person when reconsider matches the current reading again: the persona is put to the person the creation made, never a second one, and the rule takes it as that creation, on the creation's own terms judged on the current reading, the creation's statements, left undecided with its closed card, standing again with it

steps.say: the death record naming her as the deceased's mother, attached on the owner's word as hers
she is accepted by the owner: the son the record states she bore, whom nobody fits, is created by the rule
the page read again while the creation stands: his link carries to the new reading
the rule takes the creation back after the re-read: its card undecided again on the superseded reading, the person row staying
the record's open cards marked as an older matcher's: the rule leaves an older matcher's creation for reconsider to propose again

reconsider closes the card on the superseded reading and matches the current reading again: the persona is put to the person the creation made, never proposed as a new person, and the rule takes it as that creation: the current reading still names him the son of his mother, accepted on it, and nobody else fits him

expect.why: the card left on the superseded reading closes as a re-read closes the cards of the reading it supersedes

has: judged on this reading as that creation
Son of Lena Howard Bell, accepted on this record
the creation stands on this entry

expect.why: the current reading's persona of his entry, proposed as the person the creation made, and taken by the rule on the creation's own terms: the link the creation wrote from this record is no ground for him, and the creation's terms ask none
never a second Ollie Duke Davidson
the statements the withdrawal left undecided stand again with the decision on the current reading: closing a card judged nothing it stated
